title: The Hollow of the Weeping Wood
author: Yara Thornbury
blurb: Casper Lockridge, a cartographer of unmapped realms, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
